name: adversarial-review
title: Adversarial Code Review Loop
description: Multi-perspective code review: one agent finds issues, N independent refuters try to disprove each. Only findings that survive the adversarial panel are reported.
author: SolSolis-Sys

inputs.name: refuters
inputs.description: Number of independent refuters per finding

inputs.name: min_votes_to_confirm
inputs.description: Refuters that must NOT refute to confirm finding as real

agents.prompt: Analyze {{target}} along these dimensions: {{dimensions}}. For each issue: file, line, severity (critical/high/medium/low), category, description, suggested fix. Be thorough — findings feed adversarial refuters.

You are an adversarial reviewer. REFUTE this finding if possible: {{finding}}. Try to prove it is a false positive — wrong line, already handled, acceptable trade-off, or test-only code. Default to refuted=true when uncertain. Return: { refuted: bool, confidence: 0-1, reason: string }

Given findings and refutation votes, produce final report. A finding is CONFIRMED if at least {{min_votes_to_confirm}} refuters did NOT refute it. Group by severity. List filtered false positives separately.

loop.exit_condition: all findings processed by refuter panel and synthesizer
